context_granularity: One fresh read-only agent context per batch, not a new model context for each individual case; prompts instructed independent handling. The two targeted reruns used a third fresh agent.
evaluation_method: Blind task execution by subagents; primary-agent semantic scoring of actual retained responses against separately withheld rubrics. No expected answers, prior verdicts, or development history were supplied to execution agents.
model_disclosure: Session model inherited by agents; no separate per-agent model identifier reported.
limitations: Manual bounded evaluation. This is not a controlled pre/post efficacy study, a full fresh-context-per-case experiment, a scientific novelty review, or installation/client-discovery validation. Final accepted results combine the unaffected first-pass cases and two targeted reruns after localized output-rule fixes; the whole suite was not independently rerun after those fixes.
